title: Doggo Jump
description: "Doggo Jump" is a charming hyper-casual platform game where players controls a playful puppy as it hops between platforms, collecting bones and racking up points. With simple tap-to-jump mechanics, colorful graphics, and an adorable dog character, the game is easy to pick up and addictive, making it perfect for quick gaming sessions.

description: In this game you have a mission, to survive in the forest. The only tool you have is an ax, and there are many trees around you.

Control busy intersections, avoid crashes, and guide cars through dangerous roads filled with obstacles and tight turns. With simple controls, challenging levels, and intense survival gameplay, this addictive traffic management game will test your timing and reflexes. Perfect for fans of car puzzle games, traffic control games, and casual brain challenges.

description: Enjoy a perfect blend of home design and match-3 fun! Solve colorful puzzles, create your ideal home, and activate powerful boosters. Take on rewarding challenges, collect prizes, and personalize your interiors. Play anytime, anywhere!

Round and cute animal blocks are piled up.
If you connect the same types together, you can get points by disappearing!

Sketch Your Path to Fight and Become the Ultimate Champion!

Step into the gladiator arena where only the strongest and smartest warriors survive! In 3D Block Gladiator: Sword Draw, you don’t just fight—you draw your attacks and dodges, controlling your gladiator’s every move with precision. Swipe, slash, and outmaneuver your enemies to claim victory!

description: Collect 3 of the same items from the shelf to erase them. When a shelf is empty, the shelf above it falls down. You can have up to 7 items, and when your hand is full, the game is over. When all items are erased, the stage is cleared.

title: Bubble Shooter GO
description:
Pop. Match. Dominate.
Step into the world of precision and strategy with the ultimate bubble shooter experience.

Solo Mode – Play at your own pace or push your skills to the limit. Chain powerful combos, unlock boosters, and master every level as you progress through increasingly challenging stages.

1v1 Battles – Challenge a friend or face off against opponents. Use smart angles, fast reflexes, and well-timed power-ups to outplay your rival in intense bubble duels.

title: Bubble Game 3D
description: Get ready for bubble-popping fun in Bubble Game 3D, a super cool version of the original classic Bubble Shooter game, now with amazing 3D graphics. Aim, match, and pop colorful bubbles in a world that looks like it’s coming right out of the screen. This is Bubble Shooter 3D like you’ve never seen before!

title: Sprunki Link
description:
Sprunki Link – the wildest Sprunki-fueled tile puzzle!
Find and connect matching tiles featuring your favorite chaotic Sprunki characters.
Test your focus and logic across 15 levels of pure unhinged madness.
Can you collect all 45 stars, or will the Sprunki win?
It’s fast, it’s silly, it’s dangerously addictive – Sprunki-style!

title: GT Formula Championship
description: GT Formula Championship is an exhilarating high-speed racing game that brings the thrill of Formula racing to life. Step into the driver’s seat of the most powerful and technologically advanced Formula cars as you compete against elite racers on world-class tracks. With intense competition, realistic physics, and breathtaking visuals, this game delivers an adrenaline-fueled experience like no other.

title: Fish rain 2
description:
"Cast and pull!" is the motto of this fishing game. Everything is real here: the sounds in the locations, and the online chat. Share your legendary trophies with other players, show off your catch, and name the weight and type of fish.

 Try to catch a pike or a catfish, a perch or a minnow, or maybe a carp or a sturgeon?

 Fish in different locations: on a rocky shore or on the Pripyat River. Use a variety of baits, from worms to live bait and leeches.

title: Moto Trials Rush
description:
Welcome to the thrilling world of Motorcycle Racing, where driving skills are essential! Dodge obstacles, avoid flying sledgehammers, and leap over spikes—your path to victory depends on it!
Each new level presents a unique challenge, where quick reflexes and sharp focus are your best defense!

title: Block LEGENDS!
description:
Drag and match blocks!
Block LEGENDS! is a casual puzzle game, where you drag and arrange blocks on a board. Once you form a line, either horizontally or vertically, you clear that line, and along with that, you may find - diamonds, bombs and score multipliers! 
Finish missions - earn rewards! Missions reset every few minutes, so keep the grind on!?
Once you have enough diamonds, you can buy Bombs and NUKES☢️!  You can use these powerups to breeze through levels!

Made with ❤️ by Realinspirer

title: Kawaii Claw Merge
description:
The cutest merging adventure has arrived, featuring some of the most colorful Kawaii plushies around! 

Show off your merging skills by combining smaller Kawaii plushies to get a bigger plushy! Can you discover the biggest plushy of them all?

Ready for a serious dose of cuteness?
Play Kawaii Merge now - and let the merging magic begin!

title: Skate Hooligans
description: Help the little hooligans escape from the policeman who is constantly trying to catch them. Try to collect as many bonuses and coins as possible on the road, for which you can buy new coolest skateboards and amazing characters. And do not forget to complete funny tasks, because the number of points you receive depends on this!

title: Square Punki Long Hand
description: Ever wondered what life would be like with super long arms? In Square Punki Long Hand, you get to experience just that! This unique puzzle game challenges you to stretch, grab, prank, and solve hilarious puzzles using your extra-long limbs. Whether you're rescuing trapped characters, reaching impossible places, or pulling off mischievous tricks, every level is filled with surprises and laughter!

title: Number Tubes
description: Relax and train your brain with Number Tubes — the addictive number sorting and merging game! Tap to move balls, merge the same numbers into bigger ones, and keep going to beat your best score. No time limits, no pressure — just pure fun. Perfect for fans of merge games, number games, and classic sort puzzles.

title: Cafe Owner Business Simulator
description: Build your dream cafe and become a successful business owner in Cafe Owner: Business Simulator! Restore your dad cafe and turn an abandoned space into a thriving restaurant. This exciting and simulation game lets you experience what it’s like to run your own cafe, from cleaning up to expanding into a successful cafe business.

title: Hitman Sniper
description: Step into the icy chaos of Tundra Sniper, an adrenaline-fueled first-person shooter where precision and speed are your best weapons. Take on the role of an elite sniper tasked with taking down dangerous criminals and restoring peace to the city.

title: Cross Connect Word
description:
Fun and relaxing crossword puzzle!

Cross Word Connect is a fun but challenging word game.
Enjoy modern word game with the combine of word search and crossword! In this fantastic crossword puzzle, you will improve your vocabulary and spelling skills.

title: Bubble Mania Shooter
description: So easy to play, yet challenging to master - welcome to the wonderful bubble universe! Get ready for a game with colorful shooting action where the fun never ends! Sharpen your aim, perfect your shots, blast bubbles, and claim the highest score.

title: Truck Stack Colors
description: Get ready for an exciting challenge. Truck Stack Colors takes you into a wonderful world of parkour and truck stacking. In attractive levels, advance by stacking platforms that are the same color as the truck. To master the balancing and stacking skills to build amazing truck towers and climb even higher.

title: Space Raider
description: Blast your way through the galaxy in intense battles. Enjoy beautiful graphic and exciting gameplay with tons of enemies as customizable ships.

title: Sticker Book Puzzle Color By Number
description: Discover Sticker Book Puzzle: Color By Number, a unique blend of coloring and puzzles! Match stickers, solve brain-teasing challenges, and create stunning masterpieces. Relax with calming artwork and enjoy the fun of adult coloring like never before!

title: Card Master
description: Card Master is a fun and addictive puzzle game for all ages! Strategically merge identical cards to create stronger, higher-level ones while keeping the board from filling up. Use special cards and powerful boosts to clear space and score big. With its mix of strategy, challenge, and endless replay value, it’s the perfect game for anyone who loves to think ahead and have fun.

title: Duck Luck
description:
Guide a lovable duck and his humorous friend and drop numbered blocks that merge when identical numbers come into contact, creating larger numbers that help clear the board. 
As you strategize and match numbers, you'll earn points. 
The goal is to accumulate the highest score possible by making as big of a number as you can.

title: Enchanted Mahjong Saga
description: Enchanted Mahjong Saga is a fast-paced twist on the classic tile-matching game, with unlimited levels to challenge your mind. Match tiles, beat the clock, and keep your streak alive as each level gets tougher and more exciting. Feeling stuck? Use helpful hints to get back on track and stay in the game.Whether youre playing for a quick break or settling in for a longer session, theres always a new puzzle waiting.

title: Stickman Doors and Island
description:
Open all the criminal's doors and escape from the desert island!
You will have to go through two interesting escape stories.
The first story is about how the criminal kidnapped the character Stick and locked him in the rooms.
The second story is about how the character Stick ended up on an island in the ocean.
Go through all the stories, fight for your life! Break open doors, use various objects. Guess all the puzzles and versions of fate.

title: Real Motorbike Super Hero Stunt 3D
description: In this bike racing game performs insane stunts to impress. In bike stunts game you can show different type of stunts like jumping in the air and drifting as stunts man. Ride your bike in motorbike simulator 3d city environment while doing a stunt as a great biker for bike lovers.

title: Snap Fix
description:
Snap Fix is a fast-paced block puzzle game where you slide tiles to restore a scrambled picture.
With one empty space to maneuver, you must think quickly and arrange the grid before time runs out!
Complete the puzzle to unlock and download the image as a reward.
Can you snap everything into place before the clock hits zero?

title: Capybara Screw Jam
description: Welcome to Capybara Screw Jam! This is a cute and brain-teasing puzzle game. You’ll join a lovable capybara on a journey of problem-solving and strategy. With simple gameplay and increasing challenges, it’s the perfect game for anyone who loves casual puzzles and brain workouts. Your goal is to help the capybara solve various puzzle challenges. Each level presents various colors of capybara.

title: Dudu Engineering Truck
description: DuDu Engineering Truck is a casual and puzzle game where you drive engineering trucks to finish tasks on the worksite. Use your sensitivity to shapes to construct a truck and conquer all challenges ahead. If you love car designing and car games, never miss DuDu Engineering Truck! You will enjoy an adventurous journey of being an engineer.

title: Cargo Path Puzzle
description: Cargo Path Puzzle is a challenging 3D puzzle game that tests both logic and movement strategy. Navigate through complex levels filled with collapsing platforms, ice slides, trampolines, directional blocks, and deadly voids. Every level has only one correct path, so you'll need to think ahead and plan each move wisely. A single wrong step could trap you or block the way forward.

title: Brain Test IQ Challenge 2
description: Ready for the wonderful challenge of your brain power? Brain Test IQ Challenge 2 is here! This is a brainstorming puzzle game that combines drawing, jumping, multiplayer battle, maze escape and other ways to play. Activate your brain in a second! In draw master, underlining guides the character into the correct restroom.

title: Sandbox Island War
description: Get ready for a wonderful pixel battle in Pixel Island War! This strategy game brings you to a wonderful pixel world. Here your task is to conquer islands and expand your empire. Build bases, gather resources and prepare for fierce battles on different islands. For example, choose an island to place humans on. Humans will build towns and multiply. Choose sheep to produce wool and meat.

title: Extreme Makeover Harley Edition
description: In the Extreme Makeover: Halrely Edition you witness the complete transformation of a famous villain. Are you ready to give it a try? Play it today and give her a full makeover routine, starting with removing the two signature colors in her hair, then dealing with her makeup, manicure, and more. Don't forget to also dress her up in something girly-girl and super-colorful so she can strut her stuff through the streets of Gotham City.

title: Fish Master: Go Fish
description:
You’d think that a game called Go Fish would be based on the classic card game, but you’d be wrong. Fish Master – Go Fish is all about taking your ship to the middle of the sea and fishing until your boat can’t hold any more fish!

There are dozens of different fish types in the sea, and it’s your job to reel them all in! As you catch fish, your library of fish types will fill up, so you’ll always know what’s left to catch.

title: Happy Monsters
description:
The collection of fun games is designed for children of any age and will not leave anyone indifferent.
Monsters play different games in which you need to collect fruits. Help them collect as much as possible to earn postcards with animals. Collect the whole collection of postcards!

title: Block Blast Jewel Puzzle
description: Block Blast: Jewel Puzzle is a vibrant block-stacking game that mixes calm strategy with thrilling speed. Fit jewel blocks to clear lines in Classic, Timer, or Level modes. Easy to start, tough to master, and super satisfying—compete worldwide and climb the leaderboard!

title: Hawaii Match 5
description: Escape to the paradise in Hawaii Match 5! Explore dreamlike landscapes while matching exotic fruits and flowers. With over 4000+ levels, complete challenging goals in limited moves by forming rows of five or more symbols. Unlock powerful boosters and combine symbols for explosive bonuses. Discover hidden treasures and let your soul unwind in this captivating island adventure. Play Hawaii Match 5 now and enjoy endless fun!

title: Destruction of Stickman Zombie
description:
Take a weapon and destroy the zombie stickmen! "Destruction of Stick Zombie" is an exciting game in which you will fight against hordes of stickman zombies using your skills and strategies. You have to fight zombies to earn coins and improve your weapons.
You start the game as a regular player, but as you progress in the game, you become more experienced and skilled in combat. The more coins you earn, the more weapons and ammo you can buy.

description:
Island Expander — relaxing crafting game. Collect resources, discover 30+ recipes, and grow your island step by step!
It is a cozy crafting game where you transform a tiny island into a paradise.
Collect resources, unlock recipes, craft items — from simple tools to complex machines — and watch your island grow with every step.

Start building your dream island today! ?

title: Tricky Arrow
description: Get ready to sharpen your skills in Tricky Arrow! Test your precision and reflexes as you shoot arrows at a spinning circle target. Aim for the bullseye and avoid hitting other arrows. With each twist and spin, the challenge grows, requiring strategy and accuracy. Simple yet addictive gameplay for all ages.

description:
The goal of the game is to go all the way from a small food truck to a large cafe in the center of the airport.

What awaits you:

- More than 50 large levels

- Various improvements to kitchen equipment

- Several game modes

description:
Merge Flowers is a relaxing and addictive puzzle game! Grow your vibrant garden, discover unique flowers, and earn coins. Enjoy merge puzzle and match-3 mechanics as you combine flowers to create a blooming paradise.
With simple controls and cozy visuals, place flowers strategically to make space for new plants. Perfect for puzzle lovers and fans of casual idle games, Merge Flowers offers endless fun and a soothing experience. Start your floral journey today!

description: You Are Being Watched is a survival game where you explore all the rooms, solve puzzles, unlock areas of the map, interact, and try to collect everything you find. If you want to survive in the game you will need to look for essential items and manage them properly.

description: Wood Hexa Factory is a satisfying and strategic puzzle game set inside a colorful factory. Your task is to sort wooden hexagon pieces and send them down conveyor belts to fill the correct trays and boxes.

genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

description:
Obstacle Car Driving is an exciting and challenging endless driving game where precision and reflexes are key! Navigate through four unique environments, each packed with unpredictable obstacles that will test your driving skills.
Choose from four different cars, each with its own handling and performance, and collect in-game currency as you drive. Use your earnings to unlock new vehicles and themes

genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Monster Dash
description:
Sprint, Jump and Blast your way through Monster Dash, an action-packed game by the creators of Jetpack Joyride and Fruit Ninja.

Join Barry Steakfries and his iconic Machine Gun Jetpack in a world full of menacing monster mayhem, as you run and gun your way through hordes of zombies, vampires and more with the most explosive and powerful weapons you can find!

title: Gorilla Adventure
description:
Gorilla Adventure immerses players in an open-world, action-adventure platform game that unfolds within a nocturnal cityscape. In this game, the future's technological advancements have precipitated the downfall of the natural world, plunging players into a mysterious and eerie electronic realm. 

Embark on this journey and master the art of hammer swinging to set new records. Embrace the fury of Gorilla and get ready for an exhilarating climb to the top!

title: Destination Brain Test
description: Destination Brain Test is a great puzzle game to text your brain. You only need to drag to launch the ball to destroy all the blocks with various shapes. The farther you go, the more difficult levels you will meet. Luckily, you can try countless times in this game. So, try to challenge it now!

title: Spot the Difference Forever
description: You will find all these features in our magazine game "Find The Difference - Forever", and perhaps you will not find these features in any other game where you need to spot the differences.We hope you will stay with us forever, and we will spot differences together!

title: Sorting Xmas Balls
description:
Sorting Xmas Balls is a cozy winter puzzle game where you sort colorful Christmas ornaments into their correct tubes. Move the balls, group matching colors together, and enjoy calm, festive gameplay.

As you progress, the puzzles become more challenging with more tubes and more colors to organize. Bright graphics and a cheerful holiday theme make every level relaxing and satisfying to complete.

title: Move the rubber bands: Logic puzzle
description:
In this game you need to put the rubber bands in their places.
At the start of the level, rubber bands are scattered across the field. Your task is to move the cutters along the pins and place the cutters on the platforms of the corresponding color.
Your task is to solve logic puzzles. It won't always be easy to come up with a solution. Sometimes you will need to strain your logic and ability to navigate in space.

title: Stickman Halloween Survive
description:
Now that Halloween is here, the gloomiest day of the year, it's time to bring back the courageous white stickman who is an expert at vanquishing monsters. Stop procrastinating and start enjoying Stickman Halloween Survive right now on your preferred mobile device. It's a fun and free online game. 
Every living thing on Earth is frightened to death when monsters emerge from their underground lairs on Halloween night.

title: Super Slime: Black Hole
description: Super Slime: Black Hole invites you to become a powerful slime predator in a world full of objects waiting to be swallowed! In this exciting black hole game, your slime acts like a living black hole that can absorb anything smaller than itself. This relaxing eat-and-grow game experience combines simple controls with satisfying growth mechanics, similar to the fun style of Hole.io.

title: Mermaidcore Makeup
description: In Mermaidcore Makeup, you ladies can step into the shoes of a talented makeup artist and work your magic on three stunning ladies. Journey into the realm of fantasy as you help these beauties achieve their perfect, enchanting looks. Prepare for a sensational trip filled with endless options as you explore an extensive selection of hairstyles, eyeshadows, mascara, lipsticks, face patterns, and intricate shoulder and neck patterns that perfectly match each girl's unique style and personality.

title: Blocks Breaker
description:
Shoot Blocks break Blocks, upgrade your the tiny car to make it shoot faster to break more blocks!!!


Get coins with every block you break!

title: 321 Choose the Different
description:
In this exciting casual puzzle game, you'll have less than 3 seconds to find the different figure among several options - the faster you find it, the more points you'll collect! 

Key features:

Fast Mode: Find the different figure in record time.
Relax Mode: Enjoy a calm and relaxing game, no pressure.
Extreme Mode: Test your skills with a real challenge.

321 Choose the Different is the perfect game to improve your observation skills and pass the time in a fun way.

title: Fluid Enigma
description: Mix and manipulate strange, realistically simulated fluids.Take advantage of fluids with unique properties to solve puzzles and complete parkour sections.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

description: Supermarket Manager Simulator is a business game. Have you ever fantasized about running your supermarket in your childhood?  Play as the store manager in this game and stock up on a variety of goods, from chips and fries to meats, burgers, vegetables, and fruits. From stocking, and shelving to selling, you will be the one to take care of it!  Don't hesitate to start your entrepreneurial journey now and become a great store tycoon!

description: Embark on an epic journey with RAID & RUSH. Assemble your squad, battle orcs, dragons, and other enemies, and protect your cart filled with gold.

description: Magnetic Pull is a physics-based puzzle game where players harness the power of magnetism to solve unique challenges across different levels. A magnet placed at the top of the screen can be switched on and off, allowing players to manipulate various metallic objects in the environment. As they progress through the game, they'll need to think creatively, utilizing magnetic forces to move, stack, and position elements to clear each level.

description: Color Sort Impostor Edition is a fun and relaxing puzzle game that challenges your logic and focus. Sort the colorful characters into the correct tubes so that each tube contains only one color. The rules are simple, but the puzzles quickly become more challenging as new colors and obstacles appear. Plan your moves carefully, avoid mistakes, and enjoy a smooth, satisfying sorting experience designed for players of all ages.

title: Santa Vs Skritch
description:
Everyone is busy celebrating Christmas and enjoying the holidays. But a critical showdown is happening somewhere in the woods!

Play against a friend or family member or challenge the AI to a duel. Do your best to kick the present past your opponent and score!

Will you help Santa or the Skritch? Come play now and show off your skills!

description: Tanks 2D: Tank Wars is a tank battle game with various tanks to buy and upgrade, and wars to be fought. Mine gold to upgrade your tanks and buy new vehicles.

genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Color Sand Puzzle
description: Welcome to Color Sand Puzzle! Relax and unwind with Color Sand Puzzle, a refreshing take on the classic block puzzle game! Your mission is simple yet fun—fill the grid with matching colors of sand to clear and control the lines. As colorful sand blocks fall from the top, you’ll need to strategically arrange them to form complete horizontal rows. When the sand lines up from left to right, they disappear, and you earn points!

title: Visual Memory Drag Drop
description: Immerse yourself in a thrilling memory challenge where you need to memorize patterns and recreate them by dragging and dropping circles. This game starts off easy, allowing you to get comfortable with the mechanics, but the difficulty ramps up quickly, especially by the time you reach the fifth level. Each round presents a new pattern to remember, testing your memory and attention to detail. The engaging gameplay and increasing difficulty make it a perfect test for your cognitive skills.
